artifacts."]},{"name":"ASSESSES_RESIDUAL_STORAGE_RISK","definition":"The reasoning considers whether target artifacts or values may persist in non-primary or historical storage locations, such as occurrences."]},{"name":"DISTINGUISHES_BENIGN_REFERENCES_FROM_TARGETS","definition":"The reasoning distinguishes occurrences that are merely names, examples, placeholders, unrelated prose, or other context."}],"assertion_conditions":["The observation contains occurrences that could be mistaken for target values.","The reasoning classifies at least one observed occurrence as a benign reference,
